queries: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, avg_unit_price - AVG(avg_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation FROM inv) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_avg FROM dev ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Country is the customer's Customer.Country, not Invoice.BillingCountry.
The overall average is the mean of the per-invoice average unit prices, so each invoice counts once. It is not the mean over all lines.
Invoices with no lines are kept with a NULL average, and NULLs sort last. The country average deviation ignores NULLs. Ties at the cutoff are broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the line-level average of UnitPrice across all invoice lines, not the mean of the per-invoice averages.

assumptions.assumption: Country is the customer's Customer.Country (not Invoice.BillingCountry), as the request says 'its customer's country'.
The 'average across all invoices' is the mean of the per-invoice average unit prices (each invoice weighted equally), not a line-level mean.
Invoices with no lines are kept with a NULL average and sorted last; the country's average deviation ignores NULLs. Ties are not broken.
Each line's UnitPrice is averaged simply, without weighting by Quantity.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the average UnitPrice across all invoice lines (line-weighted), and each invoice's deviation is measured from that.

assumptions.assumption: Country is the customer's Customer.Country (not Invoice.BillingCountry), as the request says 'its customer's country'.
The overall average is the mean of the per-invoice average unit prices (each invoice weighted equally). The country average deviation is the mean of the deviations of that country's invoices.
Invoices with no lines are kept with a NULL average. They are excluded from the averages and sorted last.
